newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Banca Fideuram H1 96 profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Banca Fideuram H1 96 profit rises.

text.p: Banca Fideuram, controlled by Rome bank IMI, said it posted first half 1996 net profit of 60.4 billion lire against 46.5 billion in the same 1995 period.
It said in a statement it was expecting better 1996 results after 1995's 55.3 billion lire net profit even if full-year growth would not equal that seen in the first half.
Consolidated net profit would also be up on last year's 112.3 billion lire but not equal first half growth, it said.
First half consolidated net profit doubled to 80.5 billion lire from 38.2 billion in the first half of 1995.
Net loans in the first six months totalled 305 billion lire, down on the previous 356 billion, while client deposits slipped to 1.418 trillion lire from 1.585 trillion.
Banca Fideuram is one of four new stocks entering the Milan stock exchange's Mib30 blue chip index on September 25.
At 1458 GMT, its shares were off 2.84 percent at 3,415 lire in an easier banking sector on a weak Milan bourse.
